preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have been authorized via the Auth contract)
At least 2 minutes must have passed since the last lunaburn call (lastSync timestamp)
The liquidity pool (pair) must contain LUNAINU tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the lunaburn() function with percent_base1000 set to 50 (maximum 5%) after waiting at least 2 minutes since the last call. This will transfer up to 5% of the LP tokens from the pair contract directly to the owner's wallet, draining liquidity from the pool. The attack can be repeated every 2 minutes to continuously extract LP tokens.
